utv.uk.title: The 7 Up Collection
utv.uk.description: The final part of the series brings the participants together for one last reckoning with their extraordinary lives - and with the series that has followed them since childhood. Sue, Bruce, Jackie, Suzy, Peter, KC John and Andrew each revisit the hopes and expectations captured on film throughout their lives. Their stories become a collective portrait of Britain across seven decades - and of the forces of class, education, wealth and opportunity that have shaped them. Asif Kapadia brings the story to its conclusion, looking not only at the participants but at the nature of documentary itself: what can a camera really tell us about a life, and what does it mean to preserve that life on film? In its final moments, 70 Up returns to where it all began: children with dreams, ambitions and assumptions about the adults they would become. The final chapter is not about reaching 70, but everything that happened along the way - and the extraordinary privilege of having witnessed it.

As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
shoxbetwest.us.description: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison decides to get away. After adopting a new identity, she meets Alex Stone and learns to love again. All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Persona
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. (Thriller) - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Foreigner
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Red Eye
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Quantum of Solace
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan. (Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2008

showtimeextreme.us.title: Godzilla
showtimeextreme.us.description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation. - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Patriot Games
showtimeextreme.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery) - 1992

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Yards
showtimeextreme.us.description: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. (Crime drama) - 2000

skyscifi.uk.title: The Walking Dead - Guardians
skyscifi.uk.description: In the years following a zombie apocalypse, survivors seek refuge in a world overrun by the dead. Those who are left find themselves constantly on the move as they search for safe and secure locations, while being terrorised by the walking dead. (Drama, Horror, Science fiction) - 2019

skyscifi.uk.title: Resident Alien - Daddy Issues
skyscifi.uk.description: Harry has to prove himself to someone from his past. (Science fiction, Comedy drama) - 2025

skyscifi.uk.title: Primeval - Surprising Visit
skyscifi.uk.description: When a Terrorbird appears during an incursion, the team are faced with an anomaly that they cannot lock, causing chaos as the terrified creature struggles to get home. Danny reappears from his journey through the Rift Valley with a warning for the team and suspicions about their new boss. Also, Ethan's secrets are finally revealed as he takes his revenge on Emily and the team. (Adventure, Drama, Mystery, Science fiction) - 2011

showtime.us.title: Star Trek: Section 31

showtime.us.title: Terminator: Dark Fate

skyselect.uk.title: Catch Me if You Can (2002)
skyselect.uk.description: Based on a true crime story about teenage con man Frank Abagnale Jr, who cashed fake cheques worth over $2.5 million while disguised as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, and the FBI agent who caught him. (Crime drama / Comedy drama) - 2002

showtimenext.us.title: The Perfect Score
showtimenext.us.description: College is up next for a group of high-school friends, so Francesca (Scarlett Johansson), the most daring of the group, suggests they steal SAT questions in order to increase their odds of getting into good universities. Hoop star Desmond (Darius Miles), studly Kyle (Chris Evans), working-class Matty (Bryan Greenberg), stoner Roy (Leonardo Nam) and foxy Anna (Erika Christensen) sign on for the scheme. But getting into the test facility after hours proves trickier than any multiple-choice exam. (Comedy) - 2004

showtimenext.us.title: School Ties
showtimenext.us.description: When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule. (Drama) - 1992

showtime2.us.title: The Contractor

starz.us.title: Minority Report
starz.us.description: In the future, criminals are caught before the crimes they commit, but one of the officers in the special unit is accused of one such crime and sets out to prove his innocence. - 2002

starz.us.title: The Wood
starz.us.description: Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years. (Drama) - 1999

starz.us.title: Hustle & Flow
starz.us.description: DJay is a pimp living day to day on the tough streets of Memphis, Tennessee. Pushing 40, he's tired of the life he's living and dreams of something greater. When he meets up with an old friend who is now in the recording industry, he's inspired to turn his life around and uses his criminal life as an inspiration to create rap music. When he hears that a rap superstar is coming to town, DJay works a hustle to gain the rapper's attention and hopefully get signed by a label. (Crime drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2005

starzwest.us.title: Dreams
starzwest.us.description: A powerful American socialite and an undocumented Mexican ballet dancer begin a dangerous affair. When he secretly crosses the U.S.-Mexico border, she takes desperate measures to protect their future together. - 2025

starzwest.us.title: Minority Report
starzwest.us.description: Based on a story by famed science fiction writer Philip K. Dick, "Minority Report" is an action-detective thriller set in Washington D.C. in 2054, where police utilize a psychic technology to arrest and convict murderers before they commit their crime. Tom Cruise plays the head of this Precrime unit and is himself accused of the future murder of a man he hasn't even met. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2002

starzwest.us.title: The Wood
starzwest.us.description: Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years. (Drama) - 1999

starzcinema.us.title: McVeigh
starzcinema.us.description: After the deadly siege in Waco, Texas, U.S. Army veteran Timothy McVeigh hatches a sinister plan to blow up the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City. (Thriller, Drama) - 2024

starzcinema.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
starzcinema.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

starzcinema.us.title: Miss Julie
starzcinema.us.description: A baron's frustrated daughter (Jessica Chastain) courts scandal and more when she tries to seduce her father's valet (Colin Farrell). (Drama, Romance) - 2014

starzcomedy.us.title: Empire Waist
starzcomedy.us.description: Lenore is a plus-sized teenager who gets forced into the spotlight when her classmate discovers her talent for fashion. However, the fears of her image-conscious mother and Lenore's own insecurities prevent her from wearing her own designs. - 2024

starzcomedy.us.title: Another Happy Day
starzcomedy.us.description: A woman (Ellen Barkin) attends her son's wedding at the estate of her ex-husband (Thomas Haden Church). (Comedy drama) - 2011

starzcomedy.us.title: Hi-Life
starzcomedy.us.description: An out-of-work New York actor enlists friends and strangers to help him get the $900 he owes a bookie (Charles Durning). (Romantic comedy) - 1998

starzedge.us.title: Beast
starzedge.us.description: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in ONE Championship against its champion Xavier Grau. - 2026

starzedge.us.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood - Remembrance Day
starzedge.us.description: The fiery crosses have been lit across the Highlands; lovers must part, as the call to arms brings friends and enemies home and the Jacobite Rebellion begins in earnest. (Drama, Romance, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2026-09-18

starzedge.us.title: Southpaw
starzedge.us.description: Billy "The Great" Hope (Jake Gyllenhaal), the reigning junior middleweight boxing champion, has an impressive career, a loving wife and daughter, and a lavish lifestyle. However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most. (Drama) - 2015

starzencoreaction.us.title: Black Water
starzencoreaction.us.description: In the swamps of Northern Australia, a killer crocodile stalks a pregnant woman, her boyfriend and her sister. - 2007

starzencoreaction.us.title: Priest
starzencoreaction.us.description: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills. (Fantasy, Horror, Action) - 2011

starzencoreaction.us.title: Underworld
starzencoreaction.us.description: Under cover of night, vampires engage in an age-old battle with their sworn enemies, the Lycans, a clan of violent werewolves. Selene, a vampire orphaned in the wake of a bloody Lycan attack, works for the vampire clan as a trained killer. When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline. (Fantasy, Action, Horror, Thriller) - 2003

starzencoreblack.us.title: House Arrest
starzencoreblack.us.description: DeAndre (Jayceon Taylor) becomes involved in a computer chip scheme, and his girlfriend is charged with the crime and placed under house arrest. - 2012

starzencoreblack.us.title: Scary Movie 2
starzencoreblack.us.description: All the scary movie characters are back in a laugh packed sequel that scares up even more irreverent fun than the original. Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris lead a stellar cast that takes extreme pleasure in skewering Hollywood's most frightening feature films and spoofing popular culture. Starring Regina Hall, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Tori Spelling and Tim Curry, Chris Elliott and James Woods, nothing's sacred and anything goes in this outlandish must-see comedy hit. (Comedy, Horror) - 2001

starzencoreblack.us.title: Harlem Nights
starzencoreblack.us.description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy). (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Adventure, Thriller) - 1989

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Bending All the Rules
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A businessman (David Gail) and a disc jockey (Bradley Cooper) woo a free-spirited photographer (Colleen Porch). - 2002

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Scream 2
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1997

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Sweetest Thing
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When it comes to dating, Christina Walters (Cameron Diaz) has a golden rule: avoid searching for Mr. Right and focus on Mr. Right Now. That is until one night at a club when she unexpectedly meets Peter (Thomas Jane), only to see him suddenly disappear the next day. She and her best friend Courtney (Christina Applegate) decide to break the rules and go on a road trip to find him, encountering wild and hilarious misadventures along the way. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

starzencorewest.us.title: Norbit
starzencorewest.us.description: Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town. - 2007

starzencorewest.us.title: Non-Stop
starzencorewest.us.description: Alcoholic and world-weary, U.S. Air Marshal Bill Marks (Liam Neeson) lost his passion for his work long ago. Even though lives are potentially at stake during every flight, he sees the assignment as just a desk job. However, his "ordinary day at the office" becomes a high-stakes crisis during a flight to London. Marks receives a series of text messages demanding that he instruct the airline to transfer $150 million into an offshore account, or a passenger will die every 20 minutes. (Action, Thriller) - 2014

starzencorewest.us.title: Holy Man
starzencorewest.us.description: Ricky Hayman (Jeff Goldblum), an executive at a home shopping network, is on the verge of losing his job. Sales are down under his leadership, and his boss wants to replace him with his rival, Kate Newell (Kelly Preston). But then Ricky meets an interesting man named G (Eddie Murphy). On a whim, he puts G on camera, and sales begin skyrocketing. But, when the job starts to take its toll on G's formerly enlightened demeanor, Ricky begins to question whether he has done the right thing. (Comedy drama) - 1998

starzencorefamily.us.title: Yellowbird
starzencorefamily.us.description: Yellowbird (Seth Green), a tiny orphaned bird that has never left the nest, suddenly finds himself leading a flock on its migration to Africa. (Animated, Adventure) - 2014

starzencorefamily.us.title: The Dog Who Saved Summer
starzencorefamily.us.description: After their dog Zeus ruins a party, George takes him to an obedience school run by a no-nonsense instructor. When Zeus manages to fail every test, he seeks help from a trainer with special techniques. (Children, Comedy) - 2015

starzencorefamily.us.title: Sea Level
starzencorefamily.us.description: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Comedy) - 2011

starzencore.us.title: Holy Man

syfy.us.title: Ghost Rider
syfy.us.description: Years ago, motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to save the life of a loved one. Now, he transforms into a fiery, avenging agent of justice at night wherever evil roams. As the only one who can walk in both worlds, Johnny is charged by Mephistopheles himself to destroy Blackheart, a demon that wants to overthrow Mephistopheles and create a worse hell than the one that currently exists. (Action, Fantasy, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2007

syfy.us.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
syfy.us.description: Now hiding out in Eastern Europe, Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) is still struggling with the curse of the Ghost Rider -- the devil's bounty hunter. Johnny meets a priest named Moreau (Idris Elba), who asks Johnny to find a boy named Danny (Fergus Riordan) and bring him back. But there's a catch -- Satan (Ciarán Hinds) is looking for the boy too, and has a personal stake in the matter. But if Johnny can find Danny first and save the boy's soul, there's a chance Johnny can save his own soul as well. (Action, Fantasy, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

syfy.us.title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
syfy.us.description: Years before he becomes the tyrannical president of Panem, 18-year-old Coriolanus Snow remains the last hope for his fading lineage. With the 10th annual Hunger Games fast approaching, the young Snow becomes alarmed when he's assigned to mentor Lucy Gray Baird from District 12. Uniting their instincts for showmanship and political savvy, they race against time to ultimately reveal who's a songbird and who's a snake. (Action, Adventure) - 2023

bbctwoengland.uk.title: Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga
bbctwoengland.uk.description: S1 E1 Part one of two. David meets the historians who have built the Register of British Slave Traders, piecing together a comprehensive picture of more than 13,000 individuals who were investors in the slave trade, showing the links between modern British institutions and the trade in human beings. He begins by revealing how the monarchy drove the early British slave trade, with Elizabeth I and the early Stuarts giving their support to early slavery ventures.

(Comedy) - 1994

skygreats.uk.title: Uncle Buck (1989)

(Comedy) - 1989

While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down. (Action / Crime drama / Thriller) - 2005

skythriller.uk.title: Safe House (2025)

Niestety, tylko tych negatywnych, a mecz dwóch walczących wówczas o awans do Ekstraklasy zespołów ostatecznie nie doszedł do skutku. Władze Śląska Wrocław uniemożliwiły wejście na stadion kibicom Wisły Kraków, a zarządzający Białą Gwiazdą Jarosław Królewski zadecydował, że w tej sytuacji jego piłkarze nie wyjdą na boisko. Tym razem o odwołaniu meczu nie może być mowy. Przekonamy się, jak Krakowianie przywitają gości po tamtych wydarzeniach.

Piłka nożna: PKO BP Ekstraklasa - mecz: Wisła Kraków - Śląsk Wrocław
CANAL+.Sport.2.HD.pl.description: Poprzednie spotkanie obu ekip wygenerowało mnóstwo emocji. Niestety, tylko tych negatywnych, a mecz dwóch walczących wówczas o awans do Ekstraklasy zespołów ostatecznie nie doszedł do skutku. Władze Śląska Wrocław uniemożliwiły wejście na stadion kibicom Wisły Kraków, a zarządzający Białą Gwiazdą Jarosław Królewski zadecydował, że w tej sytuacji jego piłkarze nie wyjdą na boisko. Tym razem o odwołaniu meczu nie może być mowy. Przekonamy się, jak Krakowianie przywitają gości po tamtych wydarzeniach.
